#!/bin/sh
set -eu

umask 022
base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if [ ! -e "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

# Serialize replay so two invocations cannot deliver the same Message-ID.
exec 9> "$base/.replay.lock"
flock -x 9

tmp_file=
index_tmp=
cleanup()
{
    [ -z "$tmp_file" ] || rm -f -- "$tmp_file"
    [ -z "$index_tmp" ] || rm -f -- "$index_tmp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

extract_message_id()
{
    awk '
        BEGIN { in_headers = 1; count = 0; current = ""; value = "" }
        {
            sub(/\r$/, "")
            if (!in_headers)
                next
            if ($0 == "") {
                in_headers = 0
                next
            }
            if ($0 ~ /^[ \t]/) {
                if (current == "message-id") {
                    continuation = $0
                    sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", continuation)
                    value = value continuation
                }
                next
            }
            colon = index($0, ":")
            if (colon == 0) {
                current = ""
                next
            }
            current = tolower(substr($0, 1, colon - 1))
            if (current == "message-id") {
                count++
                value = substr($0, colon + 1)
                sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", value)
                sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", value)
            }
        }
        END {
            if (count == 1 && value ~ /^<[^<>[:space:]@]+@[^<>[:space:]@]+>$/) {
                print value
                exit 0
            }
            exit 1
        }

quarantine_message()
{
    message=$1
    name=${message##*/}
    target=$quarantine/$name
    reason='missing, duplicate, or invalid Message-ID header'

    if [ -e "$target" ] && ! cmp -s -- "$message" "$target"; then
        n=1
        while [ -e "$target.$n" ]; do
            n=$((n + 1))
        done
        target=$target.$n
    fi

    if [ ! -e "$target" ]; then
        tmp_file=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.replay.XXXXXX")
        cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp_file"
        mv -f -- "$tmp_file" "$target"
        tmp_file=
    fi
    if [ ! -e "$target.reason" ]; then
        tmp_file=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.reason.XXXXXX")
        printf '%s\n' "$reason" > "$tmp_file"
        chmod 0644 "$tmp_file"
        mv -f -- "$tmp_file" "$target.reason"
        tmp_file=
    fi
    printf 'quarantined %s: %s\n' "$name" "$reason"
}

record_delivery()
{
    id=$1
    file=$2
    index_tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.index.XXXXXX")
    cp -p -- "$index" "$index_tmp"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$file" >> "$index_tmp"
    sync -f "$index_tmp"
    mv -f -- "$index_tmp" "$index"
    index_tmp=
}

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -e "$message" ] || continue
    if [ ! -f "$message" ] || [ -L "$message" ]; then
        printf 'skipped unsafe spool entry %s\n' "${message##*/}" >&2
        continue
    fi

    if ! message_id=$(extract_message_id "$message"); then
        quarantine_message "$message"
        continue

        printf 'skipped %s: Message-ID %s already delivered\n' "${message##*/}" "$message_id"
        continue
    fi

    name=${message##*/}
    target=$delivered/$name
    if [ -e "$target" ] && ! cmp -s -- "$message" "$target"; then
        stem=${name%.eml}
        n=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/$stem.$n.eml" ]; do
            n=$((n + 1))
        done
        name=$stem.$n.eml
        target=$delivered/$name
    fi

    if [ ! -e "$target" ]; then
        tmp_file=$(mktemp "$delivered/.replay.XXXXXX")
        cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp_file"
        sync -f "$tmp_file"
        mv -f -- "$tmp_file" "$target"
        tmp_file=
    fi
    record_delivery "$message_id" "$name"
    printf 'delivered %s as %s (%s)\n' "${message##*/}" "$name" "$message_id"
done
